name: How much does a California-native landscape design project typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does a California-native landscape design project typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a California-native landscape design project varies widely based on several factors, including the size and complexity of the area, the selection of plants, hardscaping elements, and irrigation system modifications. A basic design might range from a few thousand dollars for smaller renovations, while extensive projects involving significant grading, hardscape, and mature plant installations can reach tens of thousands. Initial consultation and design fees are separate from installation costs. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment to ensure transparency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for California-native landscape design vary significantly based on project size, plant selection, hardscaping, and irrigation needs, with detailed estimates provided after consultation.
